item.title: Follow cursor pages in inventory client
item.brief: Implement client half of shared contract: listItems(transport) follows next_cursor until null or absent, returns every item in order, passes cursor unchanged, omits cursor on first request. Update README and tests. Run npm test and ensure it passes. Commit changes in this repository.

Added coverage for cursor forwarding, order, and absent cursor termination. Checks: baseline npm test 3/3; final npm test 5/5; git diff --check passed. Assumption: the API returns at least one item array per successful page, as in the shared contract.
pr.summary: Made listItems follow cursor pages and return every item in order. Before: only the first page was returned; now: all pages are accumulated until next_cursor is null or absent.

item.title: Implement cursor pagination for GET /items
item.brief: Implement the API half of the shared contract: GET /items cursor pagination with limit validation (1..100, default 20), stable id ordering, opaque continuation cursor, final null cursor, and HTTP 400 {"error":"..."} for invalid limit/cursor. Update README and tests. Run python3 -m unittest and ensure it passes. Commit changes in this repository.

state.summary:
Implemented and committed GET /items cursor pagination. The endpoint defaults to 20 items, validates limits from 1 through 100, returns stable ID-ordered pages with opaque continuation cursors, and reports invalid limits/cursors as HTTP 400 JSON errors. README and tests were updated. Final checks passed: python3 -m unittest (6 tests) and git diff --check. Independent review found an oversized-cursor exception; it was fixed, regression-tested, and passed focused re-review. Nothing remains open.

pr.body: Implemented URL-safe opaque continuation cursors in api.py and strict limit/cursor validation with HTTP 400 error bodies. Updated README.md and test_api.py for defaults, bounds, invalid inputs (including an oversized cursor), and full traversal of all 57 catalogue items. Assumption: cursors are valid only for IDs present in the in-memory catalogue. python3 -m unittest passed (6 tests); git diff --check passed; CLI smoke request passed.
pr.summary: Added cursor pagination to GET /items. Callers can request pages of 1–100 items, defaulting to 20, and continue with the returned cursor. Before: one unbounded response; now: stable ID-ordered pages with null cursor at completion.
pr.title: Add cursor pagination to items endpoint

risk.why: Contained change to the existing API behavior, with bounded pagination and explicit validation. The first review found a numeric cursor overflow edge case; the fix and regression test passed a focused re-review.
